description:
Your meetings contain decisions, commitments, and context that your AI assistant can't access. TeamsMaestro changes that by connecting your entire meeting history to ChatGPT.

The fastest growing AI note taker for Microsoft users, TeamsMaestro joins your calls on Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, and Zoom, automatically capturing everything so nothing gets lost.

Works great for:

- Proposals and docs grounded in what was actually discussed in meetings
- Client call preparation by surfacing everything from past sessions, then going deeper with ChatGPT
- Performance reviews backed by real context and commitments from past conversations
- Missed meeting catch-ups with the ability to ask ChatGPT follow-up questions
- Engineering workflows enriched with project background, requirements, and technical decisions from planning meetings
- Strategic analysis that combines meeting insights with documents and data


Instead of copy-pasting transcripts into ChatGPT and hoping it finds the right detail, TeamsMaestro gives your AI direct access to your meeting history. It pulls exactly what it needs, cites the right conversation, and keeps you focused on the work.

defaultPrompt: What are my open action items?
